data.tax_note: This is an official tax authority (Finanzamt) assessment of a savings bonus tied to employer-subsidised savings contributions (vermögenswirksame Leistungen); keep it with your tax records for 2025.
data.explanation: The Finanzamt (German tax office) has approved a €43.00 employee savings bonus (Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage) for 2025, based on employer-subsidised savings payments into your Bausparvertrag (building savings contract) in 2025. You don't need to do anything to receive it: the money is paid directly to your Bausparkasse once the lock-up period ends, not to you. If you believe the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the assessment simply becomes final.
data.title: Tax notice: Employee savings bonus (Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage) for 2025
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterwiesen set an Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage (employee savings bonus) of €43.00 for 2025 for Anton Musterschmidt, to be credited to his Bausparvertrag via the Bausparkasse once the lock-up period ends.
